module: Editor of the Recast navmesh (AI navigation mesh) in the World Editor, modeled on the river editor: a "Navigation Mesh" edit mode, a toolbar, an interaction in the 3D view and two windows ("NavMesh Overview": 2D grid of the tiles and shapes of the current tile; "navMeshTileView"). Six tools: tiles (selection and locking of tiles so a rebuild does not change them), outline (coverage polygon), areas (typed convex volumes Exclude/Ground/Road/Sidewalk/Water), links (off-mesh jump/drop/climb/teleport links), test (A to B pathfinding) and crowd (live AI agents). Everything is undoable. It drives the C++ functions navmeshEditor* (navmeshEditorBuild, navmeshEditorSave/Load, navmeshEditorFindPath, navmeshEditorCrowd*, etc.). The navmesh is saved with the level (onEditorAfterSaveLevel) and reloaded on opening.
notes: If the function navmeshEditorGetState does not exist (engine without this API), the window displays "NavMesh engine API not found. Rebuild the game (C++)..." and the tool is unusable.

Shortcuts: left click = select/place, Alt+click = add a node, right click = delete a node or a link. Without an outline polygon, the whole level is covered; with an outline, the outer navmesh is removed at build time.
Link types (flags): walk 1, swim 2, jump 4, ledge 8, drop 16, climb 32, teleport 64. Area types: 0 Exclude, 1 Ground, 2 Road, 3 Sidewalk, 4 Water.
The editable build parameters include cs, ch, walkableSlopeAngle, walkableHeight/Climb/Radius (in voxels), tileSize, maxEdgeLen, minRegionArea, maxPolysPerTile, etc. (see CONFIG_FIELDS).

allowGizmo.desc: Indicates whether the transform gizmo is allowed: true only when the current edit mode is "Navigation Mesh".

returns.desc: True if the current edit mode is the navmesh one.

onEditorGui.desc: Editor hook called every frame: draws the Overview and tile view windows when the navmesh mode is active (or the missing API message).

onEditorInitialized.desc: Hook called at editor initialization: registers the two windows, the "navMesh" inspector handler, the navMeshEditMode edit mode and the "Navigation Mesh" menu entry (Gameplay group).

onEditorAfterSaveLevel.desc: Hook called after a level is saved in the editor: saves the navmesh with the level.

onEditorAfterOpenLevel.desc: Hook called after a level is opened in the editor: resets polygons, areas, selection, tiles and links; the navmesh will be reloaded at the next activation of the mode.
